C: › (a degree of lightness, darkness, strength, etc. of) a colour
› literary a different type or group

example: In the Caribbean waters there are fish of every hue.
加勒比海水域的魚五顏六色。
Politicians of all hues wish to get sleaze off the agenda so that they can discuss the real issues.
各個黨派的與會者都希望將那些卑劣之事從議事日程中去掉，這樣他們就可以討論真正的問題了。

NONE: › a noisy expression of public anger or disapproval

example: There has been a great hue and cry about the council's plans to close the school.
市政會關閉這所學校的計劃受到強烈抗議。
